name: py-semver-range
instruction: Implement semver_range.py: def satisfies(version: str, range_: str) -> bool. Versions are 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH' with an optional '-prerelease' suffix. A range is one or more comma-free clauses separated by '||' (OR); within a clause, space-separated comparators are ANDed. Comparators: '>=', '>', '<=', '<', '=' (bare version means '='), plus caret and tilde. '^1.2.3' means >=1.2.3 <2.0.0; '^0.2.3' means >=0.2.3 <0.3.0; '^0.0.3' means >=0.0.3 <0.0.4. '~1.2.3' means >=1.2.3 <1.3.0. Ordering compares major, minor, patch numerically, and a version WITH a prerelease sorts BEFORE the same version without one. Critically, a prerelease version only satisfies a range if some comparator in the matching clause names the same major.minor.patch AND itself has a prerelease - so '1.2.3-alpha' does NOT satisfy '>=1.0.0'. Raise ValueError on a malformed version or range.
gateCmd:
python3 - <<'GATEPY'
from semver_range import satisfies as s
assert s('1.2.3', '^1.0.0') is True
print('gate ok')
GATEPY
verifyCmd:
python3 - <<'VERIFYPY'
from semver_range import satisfies as s

def chk(v, r, want):
    got = s(v, r)
    assert got == want, '%s vs %s -> %r want %r' % (v, r, got, want)

chk('1.2.3', '^1.0.0', True)
chk('2.0.0', '^1.0.0', False)
chk('1.0.0', '^1.0.0', True)
chk('0.2.9', '^0.2.3', True)
chk('0.3.0', '^0.2.3', False)
chk('0.0.3', '^0.0.3', True)
chk('0.0.4', '^0.0.3', False)
chk('1.2.9', '~1.2.3', True)
chk('1.3.0', '~1.2.3', False)
chk('1.2.2', '~1.2.3', False)
chk('1.5.0', '>=1.2.3 <2.0.0', True)
chk('2.0.0', '>=1.2.3 <2.0.0', False)
chk('1.0.0', '<1.0.0 || >=2.0.0', False)
chk('2.1.0', '<1.0.0 || >=2.0.0', True)
chk('0.9.0', '<1.0.0 || >=2.0.0', True)
chk('1.2.3', '1.2.3', True)
chk('1.2.4', '1.2.3', False)
chk('1.2.3', '=1.2.3', True)
chk('1.10.0', '>1.9.0', True)
chk('1.9.0', '>1.10.0', False)

# Prerelease ordering and the exclusion rule.
chk('1.2.3-alpha', '>=1.0.0', False)
chk('1.2.3-alpha', '>=1.2.3-alpha', True)
chk('1.2.3-beta', '>=1.2.3-alpha <1.2.3', True)
chk('1.2.3', '>=1.2.3-alpha', True)
chk('1.2.4-alpha', '>=1.2.3-alpha', False)
chk('1.2.3-alpha.1', '>1.2.3-alpha', True)

for bad in [('x.y.z', '^1.0.0'), ('1.2.3', ''), ('1.2', '^1.0.0'), ('1.2.3', '^notaversion')]:
    try:
        s(*bad)
        raise SystemExit('no ValueError for %r' % (bad,))
    except ValueError:
        pass
print('ok')
VERIFYPY
